basic_details.job_title: MMDSL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Software Engineer, Laboratory Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Meghalayan Medical Drugs & Services (MMDSL) has announced 9 vacancies for Software Engineer, Co-ordinator (Supply Chain Management), Pharmacist, and Laboratory Technician posts on a contract basis. Qualification requirements vary by post. The engagement offers a pay of Rs. 45,000 + EPF for Software Engineer and Co-ordinator, Rs. 41,500 + EPF for Pharmacist, and Rs. 20,400 + EPF for Laboratory Technician, with tenure ranging from 1 to 2 years. Eligible candidates can apply online through the prescribed process on or before 21 October 2026 at 4:00 PM. Selection involves screening of applications

how_to_apply: Prepare your biodata, certificates, job experience documents, and CV/resume scanned into a single PDF file under 10MB.
Access the official online application form via the recruitment portal at https://mmdsl.in/application-form.
Fill out the required details and upload your single PDF containing all testimonials.
Submit the application form electronically on or before 21 October 2026 by 4:00 PM.

rows.details: Software Engineer, Co-ordinator (Supply Chain Management), Pharmacist, Laboratory Technician
Rs. 45,000 + EPF (Software Engineer, Co-ordinator), Rs. 41,500 + EPF (Pharmacist), Rs. 20,400 + EPF (Laboratory Technician)
Shillong, Sibbari, Mangsang, Nongkhlaw, Umsning, Umran (Meghalaya)

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Applications (BCA), Computer Science (B.Sc/ B.E./B.Tech), Information Technology (B.E./ B.Tech), or a related field. (Master's Degree in Computer Applications/Computer Science/IT preferred).
rows.experience_competencies: 1 year or more experience in PHP, Laravel, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap, PostgreSQL.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate in Supply Chain, Logistics, Pharmacy, Public Health, Management or related field.
rows.experience_competencies: 3+ years relevant experience in healthcare logistics, warehousing, inventory management or supply chain operations preferred. Advanced MS Office knowledge.

rows.essential_qualification: Master of Pharmacy from a recognized institution or related field. Valid Registration with the relevant State Pharmacy Council.
rows.experience_competencies: Experience in a similar field, full understanding of pharmacy operations, advanced MS Office knowledge.

rows.essential_qualification: Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT), or B.Sc in Medical Laboratory Technology, or Degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, or Certificate Programs in Lab Technology.
rows.experience_competencies: Previous laboratory experience in a certified or Govt Lab for 2 or more years, computer literacy, and experience with Laboratory Information Systems.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MMDSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your biodata, certificates, job experience documents, and CV/resume scanned into a single PDF file under 10MB. Access the official online application form via the recruitment portal at https://mmdsl.in/application-form. Fill out the required details and upload your single PDF containing all testimonials. Submit the application form electronically on or before 21 October 2026 by 4:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. Qualified candidates may be required to undergo a written and/or practical test, followed by an interview where original certificates and testimonials must be produced.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointments are made on a contractual basis for a duration of 1 to 2 years, which is renewable.

faq.question: Q2. How are candidates shortlisted for selection?
faq.answer: Candidates undergo an application screening process, and may be required to attend a written and/or practical test and an interview.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents need to be uploaded with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must scan and upload all biodata, CV/resume, and testimonials into a single PDF file of less than 10MB.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications online is 21 October 2026 up to 4:00 PM.
